title: Rastede station
passages: Rastede (German: Bahnhof Rastede) is a railway station located in Rastede, Germany. The station is located on the Oldenburg–Wilhelmshaven railway. The train services are operated by NordWestBahn.
The station is served by the following services:
Regional services RE 18  Wilhelmshaven - Varel - Oldenburg - Cloppenburg - Bramsche - Osnabrück
S-Bahn service RS3 Oldenburg (Oldb) Hbf – Rastede – Jaderberg – Varel (Oldb) – Sande – Wilhelmshaven
